title: FFA Chapters
before:
The following, listed alphabetically by school, are chartered chapters of the Maine FFA Association (formerly known as "Future Farmers of America"), all of which are hosted at schools providing middle level or secondary education related to agriculture and natural resources. Each chapter has a designated advisor and provides leadership opportunities to its student members.

Visit the Google Earth Map of Chapters to see where there are existing chapters and opportunities for growth.

decisions.label: Make a loose address look like an address
decisions.why: 16 email addresses sit in the body of this page rather than in a contact block, drawn exactly like every other link — so the one that opens a mail window looks the same as the ones that go to web pages. The chip carries the same envelope the banner's contact link uses. The address itself does not change.

decisions.label: Let a long table be searched
decisions.why: 1 table runs to fifteen rows or more, so finding one row means reading every row. The theme already loads the search behaviour on every page and switches it on for any table marked this way — 26 tables across the site already are, including the contact directory. It adds a search box and a "show 25 entries" menu above the table, makes the column headings sortable, and pages below twenty-five rows at a time — which leaves all but the longest tables whole. Nothing is reordered and nothing changes until someone types.
